industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Products > Cables - Electricals

operating_notes.text: Total order book as of 31 March 2026 is ₹3,585 crores.
Cable capacity utilisation was 72% in Q1FY27 against 84% in FY26; house wire 61% against 69%.
Exports were 15% of FY26 sales (₹1,832.5 Cr) and 13% in FY25; cable export order book ₹821.6 Cr as of July 2026.
Top 10 customers were 13% of FY26 sales and 15% of Q1FY27 sales; retail was 46% of Q1FY27 sales.
Unutilised QIP proceeds stood at ₹162.90 Cr in bank deposits and ₹6.01 Cr in QIP Monitoring Account as of Sep 30, 2026.
Total active working dealers as on 30.09.2026 was 2,146.
Of the ₹2,000 Cr QIP, ₹1,922.27 Cr was utilised till Sep-2026; Sanand capex spend was ₹1,372.27 Cr of ₹1,450 Cr, with EHV cable production to start by Q4FY27.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,476.4 Cr (+19.3% YoY), net profit ₹284.31 Cr (+25.5% YoY).
KEI Industries reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹3,476.40 Cr (+19.3% YoY) and PAT of ₹284.31 Cr (+25.5% YoY).
KEI Industries Limited’s Board approved quarter/year-end March 31, 2026 results on May 4, 2026, with an analysts/investor call held on May 5, 2026.
KEI Industries Limited, via **Anil Gupta**, confirmed no encumbrance on shares held by it or its concert parties during FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
2026-05-07: Income Tax Department initiated search at registered office and plants
Income Tax Department initiated a search at KEI Industries' registered office, plants and other locations on 7 May 2026; company said it will update exchanges if any material information emerges.
KEI Industries hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 5, 2026, guiding for 17-18% volume growth in FY27.
2026-05-13: Income Tax Department concluded search and seizure operations at KEI Industries' registered office, plants and other locations after 6 days
ICRA reaffirmed KEI Industries' long-term bank facilities at AA+ (Stable) and short-term bank facilities/commercial paper at A1+ after periodic monitoring linked to the May income tax search.
2026-05-20: KEI Industries entered into Share Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement and Solar Power Purchase Agreement to acquire 26% stake in Solarcraft Power India 24 Private Limited for ₹5.9 Cr
India Ratings affirmed KEI Industries' long-term bank facilities at IND AA+/Stable and short-term facilities at IND A1+ for ₹3,810 Cr.
KEI Industries reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹3,776.42 Cr and net profit of ₹262.45 Cr.
KEI Industries reported Q2 FY27 standalone revenue of ₹3,777 Cr, up 38.52% YoY, and PAT of ₹262 Cr, up 28.96% YoY.
KEI Industries Limited shared the audio recording link for its Analysts/Investors Call on quarterly results (Q3FY27) approved by the Board on October 21, 2026, held on October 22, 2026.
